description: This Java source file implements a repository class for managing application information. It loads data from a database via a DAO into an in-memory map upon initialization, providing access to application info objects.

classes.name: ApplicationInfoRepositoryImpl
classes.description: Implementation of ApplicationInfoRepository that loads application info data from a DAO into a local map, with lifecycle management through Spring's InitializingBean.

methods.name: afterPropertiesSet
methods.description: Initializes the repository by loading application info data from the DAO after bean properties are set.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Public method to manually trigger loading of application info data, useful for testing.

methods.name: getAppInfoMap
methods.description: Returns the internal map containing AppInfo objects keyed by their ID.
